== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a Facebook photograph posted 24 September 2022. The Facebook photo viewer names Doug Taylor. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 4 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Lynnwood, Washington). The Facebook profile listed workplace Decipher. He commented Red 4 salutes you on Craig Spaid's Bravo 36 shirt post.

Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot (Wayback 20261030145340 of the Route C snapshot). Identification stays on this Talk page. See [[:File:Doug Taylor Facebook portrait.jpg]].
